conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service Investigations, this is Officer Mark Evans. Who am I speaking with today?
Oh, uh, this is Margaret Johnson. I got a call from this number about my taxes?
Yes, Ms. Johnson, you were contacted because our records show discrepancies in your tax filings for the last three years. The IRS takes tax fraud very seriously.
Discrepancies? I always file on time. I don't understand.
According to our audit department, you underreported income and failed to pay the correct amount in federal taxes. That is a federal offense. Do you understand the gravity of this situation?
Oh dear, I don't want any trouble. I live on Social Security. How much do they say I owe?
The outstanding balance, including late fees and penalties, amounts to $3,960. If you do not resolve this immediately, a warrant for your arrest will be executed within the next two hours.
Arrest? No, please! I can't go to jail. Can't this be fixed?
If you cooperate right now, I can help you settle this outside of court. Otherwise, state authorities will be notified, and your driver's license and Social Security benefits will be frozen.
Please, I need my benefits to live. Tell me what I have to do.
You must make an immediate payment to the IRS holding account. I will provide you with the details. Are you able to make the full payment today?
I don't have that much. I barely have a few hundred in my account. Is there any other way?
For partial settlements, we accept payments through secure digital platforms. Do you have a bank card, or can you access a nearby store to purchase gift cards for the remaining amount?
I could go to the drugstore, I suppose. What kind of gift cards?
We accept Target and Google Play gift cards. You need to purchase enough cards to cover $3,000, and we can arrange a payment plan for the rest.
That seems strange. The IRS takes gift cards?

This is a rapid settlement method authorized for fraud cases to avoid legal escalation. If you do not comply, your file will be transferred to law enforcement, and your accounts will be seized. Do you understand?
Yes, I understand. I just don't want to get in trouble.
Good. Take your ID and phone. Go to the nearest Target or pharmacy, and buy $3,000 in Target or Google Play gift cards. Stay on the line while you do this.
Okay, I'll try. I have to get my purse and shoes. Please don't call the police.
The police will not be involved as long as you cooperate. Once you have the cards, read the codes on the back to me. This is the only way to stop the arrest.
Alright, I just need a few minutes to get ready.
Hurry, Ms. Johnson. Time is running out. If we don't resolve this in the next hour, your Social Security payments will be frozen and an officer will be dispatched to your address.
